audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Coefficient-ring and Gauss-sum compatibility; The half-open negative alcove is not a fundamental domain; Universal decomposition and its use in the tensor argument
limitations: Counterevidence: Immediately preceding (2.2) uses the nonzero-mod-n exception; the shifted additive character is already introduced; the corrected Gauss sums satisfy the required identities by exact Phi21 reduction.

Counterevidence: Eta=-2a∨ excluded and rejected as a counterexample to a quantified admitted-summand claim. Steinberg shift (n-1)a∨/2 integral for oddn, so (8.12) not disproved. Final Theorem8.1.4 uses different dual SC hypothesis.

Counterevidence: Conditional tensor identity for an existing pair not refuted. Twisted rho and factor5 repair subsidiary rank-one proof calculations; no hidden full-lattice convention found. Final main theorem has different hypothesis.
Counterevidence: Standard quantum Frobenius uses order(zeta²)=5; odd l=ell not contradicted. No claim imported general theory false.

Counterevidence: Untilded J glyph on RHS6.1 acknowledged, but no alternate basis defined. Correct modular factor occurs in separate explicitly rescaled averaging6.3-6.5. True convolution exists and is unital.
Counterevidence: Correct factored quadratic, inverse/bar relation, (4.36) and abstract Satake definitions appear nearby; admitted Hecke modules and actual operator not refuted.

Counterevidence: Correct semilinearity gives product rule with h^s and twisted denominator. Definition and induction imply inversion set<0. Rank-one product of paired kappas unchanged, so bar formula not disproved.
Counterevidence: (7.26) usesT correctly; main simple-basis match uses other identity; later tilting correspondence explicitly conditional.
